question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-24 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-24
  (
    -- Age = 25 if birthday on or before 2026-09-24 and next birthday after 2026-09-24
    (
      SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) <= '09-24'
      AND
      (
        SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) < '09-24'
        OR
        (
          SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) = '09-24'
          AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) <= '2026'
        )
      )
    )
    OR
    (
      -- Age = 25 if birthday on or after 2026-09-24 and previous birthday before 2026-09-24
      (
        SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) >= '09-24'
        AND
        (
          SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) > '09-24'
          OR
          (
            SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) = '09-24'
            AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) < '2026'
          )
        )
      )
    )
  );

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-26
  (
    -- Age = 25 if birth_date's year + 25 <= 2026 and (birth_date's month, day) <= (09-26)
    -- and (birth_date's month, day) > (09-26) is false (i.e., not after)
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 <= 2026
    AND
    (
      SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) <= '09-26'
    )
    AND NOT (
      SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) > '09-26'
    )
  );

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed by customers who were exactly 25 years old at the time of the order?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on order date
  (
    -- Age = completed years based on month/day comparison
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) +
    CASE
      WHEN SUBSTR(o.date, 6, 5) >= SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 5) THEN 0
      ELSE -1
    END
  ) = 25;

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of products a, b and c only, for orders placed from 2026-01-01 00:00:00 to 2026-07-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.product_id IN ('a','b','c')
  AND o.date >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
  AND c.birth_date <= '2026-09-25'
  AND (
        CASE
          WHEN substr(c.birth_date,6,2)||'-'||substr(c.birth_date,1,4) <= '09-25'
          THEN strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)
          ELSE strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) - 1
        END
      ) = 25;

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-05-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00 by customers who were exactly 25 years old at the time of the order?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-05-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND (
    (
      SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) + 25 <= SUBSTR(o.date, 1, 4)
      AND (
        SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) <= SUBSTR(o.date, 6, 5)
        OR (SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) = SUBSTR(o.date, 6, 5) AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) + 25 = SUBSTR(o.date, 1, 4))
      )
    )
    OR (
      SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) + 25 = SUBSTR(o.date, 1, 4)
      AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) <= SUBSTR(o.date, 6, 5)
    )
  );

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of product d only, for orders placed from 2026-09-01 00:00:00 to 2026-10-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.product_id = 'd'
  AND o.date >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND c.birth_date <= '2026-09-25'
  AND (
        CASE
          WHEN substr(c.birth_date,6,2) > substr('2026-09-25',6,2) THEN 24
          WHEN substr(c.birth_date,6,2) < substr('2026-09-25',6,2) THEN 25
          ELSE
            CASE
              WHEN substr(c.birth_date,1,4) < '2001' THEN 25
              WHEN substr(c.birth_date,1,4) > '2001' THEN 24
              ELSE 25
            END
        END
      ) = 25;
